messages:
maria: @support-bot customer (acme-inc) reports hosted inference API returning 502/503 across us-west-2 since ~09:12 UTC. Multiple customers impacted. :rotating_light:
ashwin: looking into it now, pinging traces and control-plane metrics.
maria: minimal repro from customer:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
x-request-id: rwd-12345

{"error":"upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection failure"}
```
sasha: seeing a spike of timeouts in auth-session -> config-db and routing-policy service returning 5xx around 09:11-09:15 UTC in traces. Correlated with elevated config-db read latency.
ryan: logs show repeated: "jdbc.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out" from routing-policy when querying rules. Connection pool also reporting max-conns reached.
maria: customers get 502 or 503 intermittently. Some requests succeed but most fail quick.
ashwin: quick mitigation idea: enable routing-policy cached-rules fallback (serve cached routing for short window) to avoid sync DB calls. @oncall-pager can you approve a 10m fallback?
oncall-pager: approved, running playbook now `/runbook apply-routing-fallback --duration 10m`.
support-bot: playbook started by oncall-pager at 09:20 UTC.
ashwin: applied fallback and bumped routing-policy local cache TTL. Monitoring for error rate.
(5m)
ashwin: error rate back to baseline, p50/p95 latency normalizing. Config-db latency still elevated but requests no longer hit DB path.
maria: great. notified customer that we're mitigating and investigating root cause. Asked them to confirm if they still see failures. :thumbsup:
sasha: likely root cause: network flakiness on db-replica-2 causing connections to stall and pool exhaustion. Ops investigating replica networking and pool sizing.
ryan: filing incident: INC-2026-1106 with traces, spans, and sample request ids.
maria: next steps: ops to rotate db-replica-2 NIC, eng-runtime to add circuit breaker on routing-policy DB calls and safe fallback on pool-full errors, product/support to send customer follow-up. I'll draft postmortem after ops update.
support-bot: incident INC-2026-1106 created by ryan. assignees: ops/network, eng-runtime, sre.
maria: closing this thread for immediate triage, will reopen with postmortem link. Thanks all.
ashwin: :eyes:
